report.summary: Factory reset now arms only after a real 1 s hold (a tap or a lost release can never schedule it) and is performed by its own timer; a recognised voice command or timeout clears the button window so the mic cannot re-open. Builds at 2.93 MB, 20 % free.

decisions: Factory reset: the reviewer's suggestion a) is right — arm on BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START (1 s, i.e. the button was really held) and let the esp_timer perform the wipe after the remaining 9 s; any PRESS_UP disarms. A tap, a slipped finger or a lost release can no longer schedule a wipe, and the reset no longer depends on the fragile LONG_PRESS_UP window (suggestion b)). Trade-off, accepted deliberately: a hold where the release is lost still resets after 10 s of continuous hold — the same behaviour a physical 10 s hold would have.

Voice window: the audio side now clears its request flag on a recognised phrase and on the AFE timeout, so the mic cannot re-open by itself; the panel's own timer/second press already call app_audio_listen_stop().

The 6 s MultiNet recognition window vs the panel's 10 s bar was left as is: the 10 s is the spec's window and MultiNet's timeout bounds recognition; narrowing the bar would contradict the spec's stated countdown.

control.cpp: the misleading comment is corrected to describe what actually runs (the product override), which is the honest option — removing the generated single-click registration would break nothing but also gain nothing.
report.build: esp32s31 success — 0x2cc0d0 (2932944 B) in a 0x380000 partition, 20% free; check_code clean on the edited sources

findingsAddressed.finding: critical — a short press arms the factory-reset countdown, cancelled only by a release
findingsAddressed.fix: PRESS_DOWN only records the finger; the countdown is armed by BUTTON_LONG_PRESS_START at COMBO_ARM_MS (1 s held) and performed by the esp_timer after FR_HOLD_MS; any release disarms

findingsAddressed.finding: warning — LONG_PRESS_UP timing window can fire early or miss a long hold
findingsAddressed.fix: LONG_PRESS_UP is no longer used at all; the elapsed hold is measured by the esp_timer

findingsAddressed.finding: warning — a recognised phrase leaves s_btn_window set, so the window re-opens
findingsAddressed.fix: recognised phrase and AFE timeout both clear s_btn_window inside the detect task

findingsAddressed.finding: info — button window vs MultiNet 6 s vs the panel's 10 s
findingsAddressed.fix: left as designed: the spec's window is 10 s and MultiNet's own timeout bounds recognition

findingsAddressed.finding: info — control.cpp comment claimed the single-click registration was removed
findingsAddressed.fix: comment now states the hook is overridden by app_logic.cpp and that is what runs
